title: Nutty Citrusy Moroccan Steak Amlou
description: A citrusy and cozy Moroccan dish featuring fillet of steak in a rich amlou sauce, perfect for a special occasion. This vegan-friendly version uses portobello mushrooms instead of traditional steak.

ingredients.name: portobello mushrooms
ingredients.notes: stem removed and sliced into thin strips

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced portobello mushrooms and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
In a small bowl, whisk together the almond butter, honey, orange juice, lemon juice, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped almonds to the bowl and stir until they are well coated with the almond butter mixture.
Add the almond butter mixture to the skillet with the mushrooms and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer the mixture for 5-7 minutes, or until it has thickened into a rich amlou sauce.
Serve the mushroom amlou hot, garnished with additional chopped almonds if desired.
Let the dish cool to room temperature before refrigerating or freezing.
Reheat the dish gently over low heat before serving.
